WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, '(missing)') AS funding_source,
    AVG(1.0 * ss.boxy / ss.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS source_size
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  WHERE ss.boxy IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '(missing)')
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size
  FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(source_stats.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(source_stats.source_size) AS combined_size,
  AVG(source_stats.source_size - overall.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size
FROM source_stats
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE source_stats.source_size > overall.avg_size;
